description: Executes the reviewed photoshoot flow, including its declared image and video steps. Spends credits at the brief's quote. This client may show no approval prompt, so call it only when the user agreed in chat to run the brief: their message asking to generate or run it is that agreement, a request to change the brief is not one; otherwise give the quote and wait for their yes. expected_brief_revision, runs and expected_total_credits must match the latest brief; if they changed, nothing runs and the current brief is returned. The same idempotency_key never runs or charges twice.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_brief_revision.description: The board's brief_revision shown with this brief.

expected_total_credits.description: The credits this Generate charges, as get_brief returns them.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key for one Generate: never runs or charges twice.

runs.description: What this Generate runs: each Automation, its looks and its steps, as get_brief returns them.

name: confirm_brief
title: Generate Brief
